steps.en: Install the APK from F-Droid, IzzyOnDroid or GitHub Releases
steps.zh: 从 F-Droid、IzzyOnDroid 或 GitHub 装好 APK

steps.en: Search, or share a YouTube / BiliBili link into the app
steps.zh: 直接搜索，或把 YouTube／B 站链接分享给它

steps.en: Reads the page and the site's internal API itself — no Google account needed
steps.zh: 自己解析网页和站点内部接口，不需要 Google 账号

steps.en: For YouTube, earns a playback token in the system WebView and streams over SABR
steps.zh: YouTube 先在系统 WebView 里拿播放令牌，再走 SABR 取流

steps.en: Plays in its own player, skipping sponsor segments, and keeps going in the background
steps.zh: 用自带播放器播放，自动跳过赞助片段，切到后台照常播

component.zh: 基于 ExoPlayer 的播放器

value.en: You watch and listen without ads, sponsor reads, a Google login or the official app — and background play is free
value.zh: 不看广告、不听口播、不登 Google、不装官方 App 就能看能听，后台播放也不用付费

sources: https://github.com/InfinityLoop1308/PipePipe README — F-Droid / IzzyOnDroid badges, Beyond NewPipe (SponsorBlock, background playback), About sign in
